Question: Suppose that \(S\) is a subset of \(\left\{ 1, 2, 3, \cdots , 25 \right\}\) such that the sum of any two (not necessarily distinct) elements of \(S\) is never an element of \(S.\) What is the maximum number of elements \(S\) may contain?
